predecessors.name: Nanzhao
predecessors.text: all of Nanzhao's land of 900: the Dali basin and Yunnan

successors.name: Kingdom of Dali
successors.text: Duan Siping's Dali Kingdom, in Yunnan

ledger.x: 902: Zheng Maisi seizes the throne and founds the Great Changhe.
928: Yang Ganzhen and Zhao Shanzheng overthrow the Zheng family and the state becomes the Great Tianxing (Datianxing).
929: Yang Ganzhen kills Zhao and the state becomes the Great Yining (Dayining).
937: Duan Siping takes power and founds the Dali Kingdom.

certainty.note: No page gives any frontier for these three regimes; the shape is Nanzhao's last.
